args.title: Fix import error by handling quoted column names in headers
args.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

Adjust the handling logic in the CSV import process to accept quoted column names in the header line. The current error message indicates the system expects column counts to match without quotes, which leads to rejection at row 1 when quotes are present. By updating this aspect of the import logic, headers with quoted column names will be processed correctly, allowing the whole file to import successfully like when quotes are removed manually.
